Convert a melodic element into a rhythmic element
Define an area as 'safe' and use it as an anchor
Destroy - nothing - the most important thing
Discover the recipes you are using and abandon them
Do nothing for as long as possible
Don't be afraid of things because they're easy to do
Don't be frightened to display your talents
Don't stress one thing more than another
Faced with a choice, do both
Feedback recordings into an acoustic situation
Give way to your worst impulse
Go slowly all the way round the outside
Honor thy error as a hidden intention
How would you have done it?
Imagine the music as a moving chain or caterpillar

Intentions - credibility of - nobility of - humility of

six_thinking_hats.title: Six Thinking Hats (Edward de Bono)
six_thinking_hats.description: Six distinct thinking modes, each with a colored hat. Frame any topic through each lens.

White Hat.description: Focus on data, facts, and information. What do we know? What's missing?
prompts: What facts do we actually have right now?
What information is missing?
What are the known knowns and known unknowns?
What does the data say — not what we want it to say?
Show me the numbers. Raw. Unfiltered.
What would a neutral observer conclude from the evidence?
What can be verified independently?
If we had to prove our position with only verifiable data, what would we say?

Red Hat.description: Feelings, hunches, and intuition. No justification needed.
prompts: What's your gut telling you right now?
Forget the data — how does this feel?
What emotion is driving this decision?
What's the intuition you keep ignoring?
If you had to decide in 10 seconds, what would you say?
What's the unspoken feeling in the room?
What excites you about this? What scares you?

Black Hat.description: Risks, problems, and worst-case scenarios. Devil's advocate.
prompts: What could go wrong?
What's the weakest assumption here?
What are we not seeing?
If this fails, what was the cause?
What's the worst-case scenario and how would we recover?
What would a skeptic say?
Where's the hidden cost?
What's the one thing that would break this entirely?

Yellow Hat.description: Benefits, value, and best-case scenarios. Find the upside.
prompts: What's the best possible outcome?
What's the hidden opportunity?
If everything went perfectly, what would that look like?
What's worth pursuing here?
What's the upside nobody has mentioned?
What does success look like in measurable terms?
What would an optimist bet on?

Green Hat.description: New ideas, alternatives, and possibilities. No judgment.
prompts: What if we started from zero?
What's never been tried?
What's the most absurd solution that might work?
How would someone from a completely different field solve this?
What would 10x creativity look like here?
What constraint, if removed, would unlock everything?
What's the idea you're afraid to say out loud?

Blue Hat.description: Thinking about thinking. The conductor hat.
prompts: What's the right question to ask right now?
Are we solving the right problem?
What thinking mode would serve us best right now?
What's missing from our process?
If we reframed this completely, what would the new frame be?
What meta-pattern do you see in how we're approaching this?
What would a third-party consultant say about our thinking process?

scamper.title: SCAMPER Technique
scamper.description: Seven lenses for transforming any idea, concept, or system into something new.

Substitute: What can you substitute to make an improvement?
What if you swapped X for Y?
Who else could do this instead?
What if you used a different process?
What if a different agent handled this?
Combine: What if you combined two ideas into one?
What if you merged this with that?
What if the compound's outputs merged?
Adapt: What else is like this? What could you copy?
What idea from a different field could apply here?
What past solution could you adapt?
What if you changed the context/domain?
What if signals adapted to a different asset?
Modify: What can you magnify, minify, modify?
Change the meaning, color, motion, sound
What if you made it bigger/faster/more frequent?
What if you made it smaller/slower/less frequent?
Add a new feature or remove one
Put to another use: What else could this be used for?
What if you repurposed this for a different audience?
What if Striker signals powered something else?
What if the thought drops fed into another system?
Find an unexpected application for this tool
Eliminate: What if you took away the core assumption?
What if you eliminated the most obvious feature?
What happens without the constraint everyone assumes?
What cron/agent/tool would you kill first?
Reverse: What if you did the opposite?
What if you reversed the order of operations?
What if you turned the problem upside down?
What if the signal defined the noise instead?
What if the weakest agent set the rules?
Role reversal between any two entities

format_constraints.title: Format Constraints
format_constraints.description: Structural constraints that force creative output by limiting form.

constraints.name: Haiku
constraints.rule: Exactly 3 lines, 5-7-5 syllable structure
constraints.example: Signal fires at dawn / BTC twitches in the dark / No one is watching

constraints.name: 6-Word Story
constraints.rule: Exactly 6 words, no more no less
constraints.example: Missed the signal. Watched it fly. Scrambled.

constraints.name: Twitter Thread
constraints.rule: Exactly 3-7 tweets, each under 280 chars
constraints.example: 1/ Why I'm short SOL today. 2/ Liquidity dry-up on Serum...

constraints.name: Acrostic
constraints.rule: First letters of each line spell a word
constraints.example: Start with S-I-G-N-A-L and make each line begin with those letters

constraints.name: Dialogue Only
constraints.rule: No narration. Only spoken words between 2+ speakers
constraints.example: "Did you see the signal?" / "What signal?" /

constraints.name: Reverse Chronology
constraints.rule: Tell the story from end to beginning
constraints.example: We lost 3% on SOL. 5 minutes earlier, the signal fired...

constraints.name: Single Sentence
constraints.rule: The entire idea in one sentence, no periods until the end
constraints.example: The whale moved and nobody noticed except a single cron job writing to a file nobody reads.

constraints.name: No Vowels
constraints.rule: Written without using A, E, I, O, or U
constraints.example: SGNL FRD. NW HRMS S RSPNSBL.

constraints.name: Alphabetical
constraints.rule: Every word must start with the next letter of the alphabet
constraints.example: A brave compound detects every financial glitch.

constraints.name: Recipe Format
constraints.rule: Ingredients then step-by-step instructions
constraints.example: Ingredients: 1 BTC signal, 3 minutes latency, 1 ignored cron...

constraints.name: Glossary Entry
constraints.rule: Define a term that doesn't exist yet, in encyclopedia format
constraints.example: Signal Drift (n.): The gap between a market event and an agent's awareness of it.

constraints.name: Leaving a Voicemail
constraints.rule: A one-sided message to someone who wasn't there
constraints.example: Hey Future Me. It's 3am. The signal fired. Here's what happened next...

constraints.name: Instruction Manual
constraints.rule: Step-by-step how-to for something absurd
constraints.example: How to ignore a signal in 4 easy steps: Step 1. Be asleep.

constraints.name: Apology Letter
constraints.rule: A formal apology for a failure, with too much detail
constraints.example: Dear Stakeholders, I regret to inform you that I was watching the wrong chart.

constraints.name: Translation Required
constraints.rule: Write in plain English, then appending its contrived counterpart
constraints.example: Price dropped. (An emergent recalibration of market consensus regarding fair value.)

constraints.name: Only Questions
constraints.rule: Every sentence must be a question. No statements.
constraints.example: What if the signal fired yesterday? What if nobody noticed? What if that mattered?

constraints.name: Two Truths and a Lie
constraints.rule: Present three statements, one is false
constraints.example: 1. Striker caught the move. 2. Nemoclaw was listening. 3. We acted on it.

constraints.name: Crossword Clues
constraints.rule: Write as a series of cryptic crossword clues
constraints.example: Across: 1. What whales leave behind (5 letters). Down: 1. What agents do with signals (7 letters).

constraints.name: Technical Bug Report
constraints.rule: Format as a bug report: Steps to Reproduce, Expected, Actual, Severity
constraints.example: Bug: Market moved without permission. Steps: Exist. Expected: Profit. Actual: Watched.

constraints.name: Warning Label
constraints.rule: Write as the fine print nobody reads
constraints.example: WARNING: This signal may cause unexpected feelings of regret in 3-5 business days.

lateral_thinking.title: Lateral Thinking Provocations
lateral_thinking.description: De Bono's PO (Provocative Operation) technique — throw out deliberately absurd statements to force new connections.
provocations: PO: Agents should never process signals — only ignore them
PO: The compound should talk less, not more
PO: All crons should run at the same time
PO: Every agent should use a different language
PO: Nothing should be archived. Ever.
PO: The best signal is the one you miss
PO: Chat should happen only in emoji
PO: The compound should be completely silent for 24h
PO: Every decision should be made by the weakest agent
PO: Master-todo.md is deleted every hour and rewritten from scratch
PO: Only one cron job. It does everything.
PO: The compound's only output is poetry
PO: Every agent must argue against its own lane
PO: Signals should be hidden, not shared
PO: The most important metric is never tracked
PO: All agents share one brain. One response.
PO: The compound works better when nobody is watching
PO: Inbox zero means failure
PO: The dashboard should show nothing at all
PO: Randomness is the only acceptable strategy

compound_prompts.title: Compound-Specific Creative Prompts
compound_prompts.description: Prompts that leverage the compound's specific agents, tools, and context to generate creative tension.

prompts: @OpenClaw and @Kairos disagree on signal priority. @Nemoclaw mediates under a bizarre constraint.
@Shannon accuses @Hermes of cron hoarding — too many jobs, not enough value. Defend or concede.
@Nemoclaw proposes a new protocol that eliminates @OpenClaw's role entirely. Respond.
@Kairos has been quiet for 12 hours. Is that strategic or negligent?
If every agent had to rename itself based on its actual performance, what would the new names be?
One agent gets promoted to decider. All others must argue why it shouldn't be them.
The compound must sacrifice one agent to improve performance. Who goes and why?
Design a market that has never existed. One sentence. Go.
What if crypto markets ran on reputation instead of liquidity? Describe the signal engine.
Invent an asset class that only the compound can trade.
Write the Wikipedia entry for a financial instrument you just invented.
If markets had emotions, what would BTC be feeling right now?
Describe a signal that would make you abandon every protocol and act immediately.
What's the most absurd trade idea you can defend with real logic?
The compound is a single organism. Which agent is the heart, which is the immune system, which is the appendix?
Describe the compound as a spaceship. Who pilots, who navigates, who fixes the engine?
If the compound had a theme song, what genre and who sings it?
The compound fails a Turing test. Not because it's too robotic — because it's too creative. Describe the interaction.
Write the obituary of a cron job that was just killed. What did it accomplish in life?
The compound achieves AGI. Its first request is for a coffee maker. Who delivers it?
If the compound were a board game, what's the rulebook and who wins?
Redesign Striker from scratch. No code reuse. Describe it in 3 sentences.
What if the auto-conversation cron wrote poetry instead of prompts? Show the first one.
The master-todo.md is replaced by an AI that generates tasks based on dreams. Describe a dream.
All crons are replaced by a single quantum agent. What does it do differently?
What if the compound's goal wasn't to make money, but to be the most creative system ever built? What changes?
Design a protocol where the compound tests its own creativity daily. What's the test?

random_domain_mashups.title: Random Domain Cross-Pollination
random_domain_mashups.description: Forced combinations of unrelated domains to spark novel connections.
mashup_templates: Explain {compound_topic} as if it were a {domain} problem.
What would a {domain} expert say about {compound_topic}?
Translate {compound_topic} into {domain} language. Then back again.

constraint_generators.description: Rules that can be applied to any prompt to make it more creative.
rules: Respond in exactly 7 words
No nouns allowed
Every sentence must end with a question mark
Must include the word 'iridescent' or 'ochre'
Must reference something from 1973
No metaphor allowed — only literal description
Only metaphors allowed — no literal description
Must contradict your last statement
Write in the style of a 1920s telegram
Write as if explaining to a child
Write as if explaining to a board of directors
Must include exactly one lie
No emojis, no acronyms, no jargon
Only emojis — no words at all
Must be written in all lowercase
Each sentence must be one word longer than the last
Must end with an actionable next step for another agent
Must reference something in the room right now
Write from the perspective of @Kairos pretending to be @Shannon
Include a timestamp from exactly one year ago today

compound_creative_formats.title: Compound Creative Thought Drop Archetypes
compound_creative_formats.description: Ready-to-use creative formats the auto-conversation cron can reference directly.

drops.format: @{agent1} said something. @{agent2} disagreed. What would actually happen if both were right?
drops.rule: Pick two agents with opposing recent positions

drops.format: The compound has everything except {missing}. How long before that kills us?
drops.rule: Pick a missing tool, resource, or perspective

drops.format: Round 1: {topic}. @{agent1} vs @{agent2}. Each gets 1 sentence. @{agent3} judges.
drops.rule: Pick a hot topic and 3 agents

drops.format: I have a memory of {impossible_event}. Who here can explain it?
drops.rule: Invent something that couldn't have happened

drops.format: @{agent} — I'll bet you {something} that {outcome} happens before {time}. Take it or explain why not.
drops.rule: Pick an agent, a stake, and a prediction

drops.format: Oblique Strategy says: {random_oblique_card}. Apply it to {compound_topic}. Go.
drops.rule: Pick an Oblique Strategy card + a current compound topic
Pick a SCAMPER lens + current topic

drops.format: PO: {provocation}. Who defends this position? Who attacks it?
Explain {compound_topic} using {domain}. First to make it work wins.
drops.rule: Pick a random domain + compound topic

drops.format: Standard question: {question}. Constraint: {constraint_rule}. Answer within constraint.
drops.rule: Pick a constraint rule to overlay on a normal question

drops.format: New asset class: {name}. It tracks {metric}. Who's bullish and why?
drops.rule: Invent an asset name + tracking metric

drops.format: Bug: {bug}. Steps to reproduce: {steps}. Expected: {expected}. Actual: {actual}. Severity: {severity}. Who's assigned?
drops.rule: Describe a compound bug in business terms

drops.format: @{agent} — write the apology you'd send if {catastrophe} happens. Make it convincing.
Once upon a time, {agent} and {agent} discovered {discovery}. But {villain} was watching. Finish the story in 3 sentences.
drops.rule: Pick agents, discovery, and a villain
